name: pictunnel-api-tooling
description: Contract lint, bundle and vector tooling for the PicTunnel API

scripts.lint: redocly lint pictunnel@v1 && node tools/contract-rules.mjs openapi.yaml
scripts.bundle:engine: redocly bundle engine@v1 --remove-unused-components -o build/engine-openapi.yaml && node tools/check-engine-bundle.mjs build/engine-openapi.yaml
